description: Start a cloud coding-agent session on a repository. Returns the new session in phase creating; it does not return an attach ticket (call attach_agent_session for one). Pass outputSchema (a JSON Schema) to get a machine-readable result: the agent submits one that validates against it and outcome.result carries it, or the turn fails with failureReasonCode STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_MISSING. Pass secretNames (workspace agent secrets) and secrets (inline, this session only) to give the agent API keys as env vars; values are redacted from the transcript. Pass skills to make the turn follow workspace skills (list_agent_skills).

maxSpendUSD.description: a ceiling on this session's platform model spend in USD (more than 0, at most 100000); the turn fails AGENT_MODEL_SPEND_CAP_REACHED with scope session once reached. Needs the platform model route; a session on the workspace's own model key is refused AGENT_SESSION_SPEND_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE

outputRequired.description: default true when outputSchema is set: a turn that ends without a final valid result fails STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_MISSING

outputSchema.description: a JSON Schema 2020-12 object (at most 64 KiB, no external $ref) the turn's result must satisfy; read it from outcome.result

parentSessionId.description: start this session as a child of the active session with this id (same workspace; you need to be able to operate it): at most 3 levels deep and 5 live children per parent. The child's spend counts against the parent's maxSpendUSD ceiling and may not exceed what is left of it; the child inherits the parent's secrets, and secretNames may only narrow them (inline secrets are refused)

secrets.description: inline secrets for this session only, deleted with it; an inline name wins over a workspace secret of the same name. At most 20 secrets per session in total

name.description: the env var name the agent reads: [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* (at most 128), not a platform-reserved name such as BEX_* or PATH

value.description: the secret value, 1 B to 32 KiB; write-only, redacted from the transcript

description: Read a workspace's agent environment: the sandbox network tier (registries = GitHub plus the built-in package registries for the whole session, the default; custom = registries plus customHosts; full = any public host over HTTP(S) through the bex egress proxy, with model providers blocked and no raw TCP or SSH), the custom hostnames, the default model, whether the model is pinned by the platform model route, the model source (byo = the workspace's own model provider key, platform = bex-provided and billed at the provider's cost + 30%, none) with modelKeySet (the key itself is never returned), and the agent-model spend controls: the effective monthly spend cap in USD (min of the admin override or plan default and the billing trust tier's ceiling), the plan default, the override, month-to-date spend, the trust tier (T0..T4) and the next charge threshold, whether a failed or disputed payment holds the tier (trustTierLocked), whether the tier's ceiling sets the cap (agentModelSpendCapTierLimited), whether new platform-model requests are refused at the cap now (agentModelSpendCapReached: false while the next request would charge the card at the tier's threshold instead), whether reaching the next charge threshold charges the card and the workspace keeps working (agentModelChargesAtThreshold), and whether an unpaid failed invoice refuses platform-model requests (billingBalanceDue).

description: Read the complete output of one tool call in a cloud coding-agent session. description: Read one page of a cloud coding-agent session's durable conversation transcript, seq-ordered: each part is a completed item (a UIMessage text, reasoning or dynamic-tool part; a data snapshot; or a start/finish chunk), partial when the live stream ended inside it (a later page may carry its complete copy under a new seq with the same turn and partIndex, which supersedes it; render parts in turn, partIndex order). Works for live, completed, and archived sessions; page by echoing nextAfterSeq as afterSeq until parts is empty.
